milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The polished granite slab landmark is at (-15, 0, -15) relative to spawn (~21 blocks away). Player must navigate to within 5 blocks and face it, confirming they have located the NW landmark area. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk there rather than detecting it from spawn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The potted lily of the valley is at (16, 0, -5) relative to spawn (~17 blocks away). Player must navigate to within 5 blocks and face it, confirming they have located the garden area in the East.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The oak door is at (6, 0, 13) relative to spawn (north wall of the sealed stone brick building, ~14 blocks from spawn). Player must navigate to within 5 blocks and face it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The birch trapdoor is at (-10, 0, 14) relative to spawn (on the stone platform in the SW area, ~17 blocks from spawn). Player must navigate to within 5 blocks and face it.

Uses inventory_has because mining lily_of_the_valley drops the flower item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no lily_of_the_valley, so any amount in inventory confirms successful mining. Flowers break instantly by hand.

Uses inventory_has because mining a honey_block drops the honey_block item into the player's inventory. Honey blocks can be broken by hand (no tool required) and drop themselves. The player must mine at least one honey block to access the fishing rod alcove.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_trapdoor places the result in the player's inventory. Recipe: 6 dark_oak_planks in a 2x3 pattern yields 2 trapdoors. Materials are in the basement chest accessed via birch_trapdoor. Player starts with none.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_pressure_plate places the result in the player's inventory. Recipe: 2 dark_oak_planks side by side. Materials are in the basement chest. Player starts with none.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron_door places the result in the player's inventory. Recipe: 6 iron_ingots in a 2x3 pattern yields 3 iron doors. Iron ingots are in the chest inside the sealed building accessed via oak_door. Player starts with none.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a leather_chestplate places the result in the player's inventory. Recipe: 8 leather in a tunic pattern (all slots except top-center in 3x3 grid). Leather is in the chest inside the sealed building. Player starts with none.

Uses inventory_has because the goal is to have a snowball in inventory. NOTE: There is no vanilla Minecraft crafting recipe for snowballs — they are obtained by mining snow_blocks with a shovel (each yields 4 snowballs). The scene provides snow blocks and a wooden shovel in the cold storage room adjacent to the granite slab area. The milestone checks for the item in inventory regardless of acquisition method.

milestones.task: Hook a spider using fishing rod.
milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='mob', max_count=0) because the spider arena is designed so that hooking the spider with a fishing rod pulls it off a 1x1 cobblestone pillar into a 20-block deep lava pit, killing it. The spider has NoAI:1b and PersistenceRequired:1b so it cannot naturally despawn or wander — the ONLY way it disappears is by being pulled into lava via fishing rod hook. The box [14,-20,13] to [20,5,19] tightly encompasses the entire spider arena including the lava pit below.
